section.heading: What is XML Authoring?
section.paragraph: XML authoring is the process of creating and editing structured content using Extensible Markup Language. Unlike word processors, XML authoring tools enforce semantic structure rather than visual formatting.
This tool demonstrates a professional authoring workflow where the document always flows through a canonical internal model.
Learn more at the W3C XML specification.

section.heading: Key Features
section.paragraph: The following features are supported in this MVP release:

list-item.paragraph: Upload any valid article XML file
Edit content with rich text formatting
Download the updated XML with preserved structure

section.heading: Authoring Workflow
section.paragraph: The application follows a strict layered architecture:

list-item.paragraph: Validate structure against the supported vocabulary
Convert to the Internal Document Model
Render in the Tiptap rich-text editor
Synchronize edits back to the Internal Document Model
Serialize to clean, well-formed XML on download

section.heading: A Note on Nested Sections
section.paragraph: Sections can be nested to arbitrary depth. Each section creates a logical grouping with a visual left-border indicator in the editor.

section.heading: Inline Formatting
section.paragraph: You can use bold, italic, underline, and links inline.
Formatting can be combined for emphasis when needed.
